messages:
anya (eng): Postmortem posted — short chain: mass token renewals + a metadata scrape caused a spike in auth requests to our vendor, they rate-limited and our fallback flow amplified calls. Impact: ~6m elevated errors for hosted inference. doc: https://redwood.in/postmortems/1978004321
max (sre): Timeline: auth 429s spiked at 04:18 UTC, KV cache cold starts worsened the fanout. We should add single-flight refresh, per-process token cache, and throttling on the client side.
leo (vendor-relations): Vendor opened VEND-2033. They've asked for a 2-min trace and the approximate QPS pattern. I'll send their support the trace and request guidance on safe testing windows.
maria (security): Action: add jitter to rotation schedules and verify HSM audit entries for rotates. Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-04-06.
joanna (legal): I'll pull the contract excerpt about rate-limits and permitted testing. Will share a notice template for vendor dry-runs. ETA: 2026-03-29.
anya (eng): Short-term action: implement single-flight token refresh + in-process cache to prevent parallel refresh storms. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-03-23. I'll open a PR and link it in the postmortem.
max (sre): Medium-term: route-level circuit-breaker and client-side exponential backoff + an alert when auth 429/5xx > 3% for 5m. Owner: max. ETA: 2026-03-30.
leo (vendor-relations): Proposed dry-run with vendor: 20m controlled token-throttle while we validate fallbacks. Need legal ok and vendor sign-off. Target week of 2026-04-12.
ci-bot: Created ticket RI-4217 for single-flight token cache (assigned to anya).
anya (eng): Safe reproduce snippet for staging (will add to CI harness):
```sh
for i in {1..300}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://model-reg.staging.internal/v1/meta &
  sleep 0.01
done
```
maria (security): Also require KMS rotation runbook steps and an emergency revoke checklist before we do vendor tests. I'll PR the runbook. ETA: 2026-03-25.
max (sre): Ops checklist for dry-run: 1) notify vendor/legal 2) enable staging throttle 3) enable circuit-breaker 4) run harness 5) monitor SLOs + paged alert. I'll draft and share.
joanna (legal): Confirmed contract permits non-disruptive testing with 72h notice. I'll prepare the notice and publish the template.
leo (vendor-relations): I'll request vendor guidance on rate-limit headers and whether they can provide a temporary elevated window for our test.
anya (eng): Ownership summary: anya -> token cache + CI harness; max -> circuit-breaker, alerts, ops checklist; maria -> KMS/runbook + rotation audit; leo -> vendor coordination + test scheduling; joanna -> legal notice.
max (sre): Suggest adding label "vendor-auth-burst" to incident taxonomy to track recurrence patterns. Owner: max. ETA: 2026-03-27.
anya (eng): Long-term: evaluate dual-auth-path (backup internal token service) to reduce single-vendor blast radius. Spike owner: anya. ETA: 2026-05-20.
leo (vendor-relations): Will confirm vendor test window by 2026-04-01.
ci-bot: Weekly follow-up reminder set for 2026-03-30.
anya (eng): Thanks — I'll update the postmortem with owners, PR links and a short verification checklist. End thread.
